scripts.build: npm run build:games && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.test: vitest run && npm test -w games/canto-numbers && npm test -w games/hk-map
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run playtest:build && npm run playtest:phone
scripts.build:games: npm run build -w games/canto-numbers -- --outDir ../../public/games/canto-numbers --emptyOutDir && npm run build -w games/hk-map -- --outDir ../../public/games/hk-map --emptyOutDir && node tools/front-page.mjs
scripts.hkmap: npm run data -w games/hk-map && npm run fonts -w games/hk-map
scripts.playtest:phone: node tools/playtest.mjs --project . --mode build --device iphone --path arcade/ --scenario playtest/phone
